items.name: Chääswürfel 2025
items.information: [DE] Während des Turniers veranstalten wir ein gemeinsames Raclette-Essen. Wir würden uns freuen, wenn auch du dabei bist und zusammen mit uns ins neue Jahr "cubest". Im **Tab "Raclette" f**indest du alle wichtigen Informationen. Bitte beachte, dass der **Anmeldeschluss für das Raclette-Essen vor Anmeldeschluss der Competition liegt**. [EN] During the competition, we will have a raclette dinner together. We would be delighted if you could join us and "cube" into the new year. You can find all the important information in the **"Raclette" tab**. Please note that the **registration deadline for the raclette dinner is before the competition registration deadline**.

items.name: Farewellington 2025
items.information: ### Please check the schedule! Farewellington 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. items.name: Festligt Farvel til 2025
items.information: Vi gentager sucessen af sidste års nytårskonkurrence! Der vil blive bestilt noget mad udefra, som vil koste omkring 300kr. Når vi nærmere os datoen vil alle tilmeldte modtage en mail, med informationer om tilmelding og betaling af aftensmaden samt andre praktiske oplysninger. __________________________________________________________________________________________ We are repeating the success of last year's New Year's competition! We will be providing a dinner option, which is expected to cost around €40. As we get closer to the date, everyone who is registered will be sent an email with information about registration and payment for the dinner, as well as other practical details.

items.name: New York New Year 2025
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. Please note the schedule of this competition - there are events/rounds taking place from **9pm** on New Year's Eve (December 31, 2025) to **2am** on New Year's Day (January 1, 2026), and then 9:30am to 1:30pm on New Year's Day.
